periocular_spatial_geometry.dominant_axis_orientation: Oblique orientation, approximately 50-60 degrees downward and outward relative to the horizontal facial axis.
periocular_spatial_geometry.aspect_ratio_factor: High vertical aspect ratio; the eye patches are distinctly oval and vertically elongated rather than circular.
periocular_spatial_geometry.inferior_centroid_shift: Pronounced downward tapering with the lowest point of the patch extending significantly below the geometric center of the eye.

cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.inter_bounding_box_euclidean_distance: The gap between the ears spans the width of the superior cranial vault, indicating a wide lateral placement.
cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.apex_contour_smoothness: The superior boundaries of the pinnae exhibit smooth, semicircular curvature with no visible flattening.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A prominent, dark, roughly oval-shaped patch of missing fur or a lesion is visible on the upper ventral torso (sternal region).
other_distinctive_markers: Clearly visible maxillary and mandibular dentition, including canines, exposed by the open-mouth posture while feeding.
